title: Claude Code adds AGENTS.md support for shared project instructions
friendlyTitle: Claude Code can now use the same instruction file as other coding agents
summary: Claude Code 2.1.277 now reads AGENTS.md when a folder does not contain CLAUDE.md. Anthropic says the behaviour is an early built-in example of its forthcoming ‘mods’ system and can be disabled in configuration.
friendlySummary: Claude Code now reads AGENTS.md when it cannot find its own CLAUDE.md file. Teams can turn the feature off if they do not want it.
whyItMatters: Teams using several coding agents can keep one set of repository instructions instead of maintaining a separate file for every tool. The fallback rule preserves Claude-specific instructions where teams need them while improving portability elsewhere.
friendlyWhyItMatters: One shared instruction file means less repeated setup when a team uses different AI coding tools. Special Claude instructions can still take priority.
